title: PR status
description: A badge on a worker's card naming the pull request of its branch and where it stands: open, draft, merged or closed.

every.description: How often it asks about a branch whose pull request is open, such as "2m" ("s", "m" or "h"): 30 seconds at least. A branch with none, or with one merged or closed, backs off to 5, 15 then 30 minutes while nothing changes, and every branch is asked about as its worker ends a turn.

gh.description: The GitHub CLI as the tower runs it: its argv before the subcommand (`repo view`, `api graphql`).

seen.description: What GitHub said of a checkout's branch, appended only when it changed: its newest pull request, none, or why it couldn't be asked.

p.description: What GitHub said of the branch: its newest pull request from a head of the branch's name, or null for none, and whether git took it for this branch's.

dir.description: The checkout's folder `gh` was run in.

review.description: Its review decision as GitHub names it; null when none is required. Absent from facts written before it was asked.

checks.description: The state of the checks on its newest commit as GitHub rolls them up; null with none. Absent from facts written before it was asked.

headOid.description: Its head commit. Absent from facts written before it was asked.

createdAt.description: When it was opened, ISO 8601. Absent from facts written before it was asked.

mine.description: Whether the pull request is this branch's, as git read the checkout: its head commit in the branch's history and, merged or closed, opened after the branch was made. A false one is a branch name reused, and shows no badge. Absent from facts written before it was asked.

f.description: `gh` gave no answer for the branch, and why: the end of its stderr. The pull request seen before it is kept.

x.description: The pull request of the card's branch, when it has one.

review.description: An open pull request's review decision.

checks.description: The checks on its newest commit, rolled up.

ask.description: Ask GitHub about one checkout branch now, as a round asks about each. Its board trigger calls it as a worker in a worktree ends a turn.

dir.description: The checkout folder to run gh in.

changed.description: Whether what GitHub said differed from what was last seen, and was appended.

ask-now.description: Ask GitHub about every worker's branch now, whatever their backoff says, after any round in flight.

asked.description: How many branches it asked about.

words.label: Ask GitHub now
words.hint: Read every worker's pull request now

prs.description: Every branch it has asked about, newest answer first: its pull request, none, or why GitHub couldn't be asked, and when it asks next.

dueAt.description: When it asks about the branch next, epoch ms; absent until it has asked since it started.

status.description: Whether it can ask GitHub about the branches it asked about since it started: its line when it can; refused, naming why and what to do, while any branch's latest ask failed for a reason other than its checkout not being on GitHub.

words.label: PR status can ask GitHub about the workers' branches
